name: Activity Monitoring Dataset
description: This paper addresses the lack of a commonly used, standard dataset and established benchmarking problems for physical activity monitoring. A new dataset - recorded from 18 activities performed by 9 subjects, wearing 3 IMUs and a HR-monitor - is created and made publicly available. Moreover, 4 classification problems are benchmarked on the dataset, using a standard data processing chain and 5 different classifiers. The benchmark shows the difficulty of the classification tasks and exposes new challenges for physical activity monitoring.
evaluation_method: accuracy (per-class accuracy / overall classification accuracy), often complemented by F1
reputation: An early, influential wearable-sensor HAR dataset used to benchmark classical activity-recognition pipelines, though superseded by larger modern datasets.
notes: Small number of subjects (9) and activities (18) — risk of overfitting and limited generalization; multimodal sensor data (IMUs, HR) but not large-scale; non-LLM benchmark.
